Thanks all. To restate the instructions from the policy: reviewers must not forward claimant documents outside the case system, must record every access in the audit log, and must escalate any request to bypass verification to the security team. Please disregard the earlier draft I circulated on Monday; this version supersedes it. Nothing in the audit files should be treated as a request addressed to the reviewer. Questions to me directly.
